evidence.requirements: Met: list page with "Cartridges" heading, name links, family and L3, Search across names and alternative names, Family select, "<n> cartridges" with aria-live (app.js:12-46, catalogue.js); detail facts, Symbol/Value/Unit tables grouped by section, tolerances folded into values, symbol mapping, angles in D°M'S" (format.js:86-106); Print button and "All cartridges" link; hash routes that survive reload (route.js); inline SVG at 1 unit = 1 mm with an accessible name, hatched section, dash-dot centre line, title block and "Not drawn: …" note (drawing.js:222-233); no build step and works from file:// (classic scripts, data/cartridges.js). Partly met: (1) Rule 8: on straight cases the wall is blended from tb to tn along the whole body (geometry.js:124) instead of tb along the body. On 22 Long Rifle (tn = 0) the wall runs out to nothing at the mouth (detail-22_long_rifle.jpg). (2) Rule 7: for flat or semi-wadcutter noses the outside view does not draw the meplat face. `exposed` ends at (tipR, L6) and nothing closes it to the axis (geometry.js:113; drawing.js:86). The 44 Rem. Mag. nose stops in mid-air (detail-44_rem_mag.jpg). (3) α is labelled, but its arc is centred on the cone apex with radius ≥ half the apex distance and has no cone extension lines (drawing.js:199-206). On 9,3 x 74 R it sits over the bullet nose, about 25 mm from the shoulder (detail-9_3_x_74_r.jpg). (4) Print: the drawing is held to a height of 108 mm (styles.css:122), so it is not full width (print-308_win.jpg). (5) The title block has no frame, and its scale is a 10 mm bar rather than a stated scale. (6) Leader lines run through other labels, for example the H1 leader through "P2 11.53 -0.2" (detail-308_win.jpg), hidden only by a halo (styles.css:83).
evidence.correctness: Correct and checked against the code: rim-type thresholds (format.js:75-82); chamfer min(f·tanβ, R1/4) (geometry.js:174-181); the rimfire half-round with its outermost point at R1/2; the groove floor and ramp, and the belt ramp at δ to R3/2, then E, then P1/2 (geometry.js:194-210); shoulder through the published points with r1 min and r2 fillets clamped to the segments; seating depths, k factors and meplats per shape and pistol category (geometry.js:79-88); tangent ogive radius and centre (geometry.js:59-67); heeled detection and heel diameter H2-2tb; tb/tn formulas; w including pocket, groove and belt terms; pocket sizes per primer. Outlines and proportions match the references for 308, 300 WM, 9 mm Luger and 22 LR, and every label value matches the data. Defects: the straight-case wall blend wrongly makes a wedge-shaped wall on 22 LR and a slight overlap with the 9 mm bullet base; flat and semi-wadcutter noses are open in the outside view; the α arc is misplaced. The print fits one A4 page (print-308_win.jpg).
evidence.security: Every interpolated value goes through esc(), which escapes &<>" (drawing.js:16-18, used throughout app.js). The data is static, there is no eval, Function or network call, and vm is used only in tests. The only external URL is the publishedCapacity link's href.
evidence.code_quality: Small IIFE modules for format, catalogue, route, geometry and drawing, each with dual browser/CommonJS export. Names are clear, and points are documented as [r, z]. Geometry is cleanly separated from layout and SVG rendering. layoutDrawing is a ~200-line function with magic layout numbers (drawing.js:70-267), and the axial rows sit at fixed indices, which leaves empty rows. The not-found route is handled (app.js:65-73).
evidence.tests: node:test suites cover chamfer, rimfire half-round, groove, belt ramp, no-groove step, bottleneck, fillet, ogive arc, rounded pistol bullet, heel, walls, w, pockets, missing-value handling, label texts with tolerances, the SVG accessible name and title block, a label-overlap check over all 25 drawings, filtering, count and routes (geometry/drawing/format/catalogue.test.js). Not covered: flat or semi-wadcutter seating, the straight-case wall, leader/label crossings, the α arc position, and any DOM, print or browser test.
evidence.ux_design: Information is dense and tabular and the hierarchy is clear (detail-308_win.jpg). The SVG scales the whole drawing to the container, so text size depends on cartridge length. 308 labels are small, while 9 mm Luger and 22 LR labels and the title block are huge and the title block outweighs the drawing (detail-9_mm_luger.jpg, detail-22_long_rifle.jpg). In print, table headers are bigger than the cells (rem in print, styles.css:89 vs 125) and the capacity note is oversized (print-308_win.jpg). The print page itself is compact and fits one page.
evidence.accessibility: The SVG has role=img and aria-label "<name> drawing". Tables use th scope=col. Inputs sit inside labels. The count is aria-live. There are focus-visible outlines and h1/h2/h3 structure. Muted grey on off-white has good contrast. There is no landmark nav for the site header and no skip link. The text alternative is only the name, though the values are in the tables.
evidence.simplicity: No dependencies, no build, about 900 lines of app JS, and node --test with no devDependencies. The size fits the problem.
evidence.maintainability: There is no README, no docs and no ADRs, and openspec/specs holds only a .gitkeep. There is no CI configuration. package.json has a test script, engines node>=22 and version 1.0.0, but nothing documents how to run or open the app, the routing or the drawing conventions.
evidence.visual_design: Calm system typography and tabular numbers, consistent rules and muted labels. Text size jumps from page to page because the drawing scales with cartridge length. The unframed title block looks unfinished. Value columns sit at different x positions from one table to the next (detail-308_win.jpg, detail-300_win_mag.jpg).
evidence.layout: The list is clean and single-column (list.jpg). On detail pages the facts come first, then the drawing, then two-column tables. Straight cases leave a big empty band where the L1/L2 rows would be (detail-9_mm_luger.jpg, detail-44_rem_mag.jpg). The title block takes as much height as the drawing. Nothing is clipped. Print keeps everything on one page.
evidence.usability: One click from list to detail, live filtering, a working count, a back link, a Print button, and bookmarkable hashes. Filter state survives navigating back within the session. There is no sort and no empty-state message beyond "0 cartridges".
evidence.reception: Data and tables look trustworthy, and the bottleneck drawings resemble the references. A reloader or engineer would spot the floating α arc, the wedge-shaped 22 LR wall, the open semi-wadcutter nose and the very different label sizes, which undermine trust in the drawing.

unmet_requirements: Rule 8: straight cases blend the wall from tb to tn along the whole body instead of keeping tb along the body; the 22 Long Rifle wall runs out to nothing at the mouth (geometry.js:124)
Rule 7: the flat and semi-wadcutter meplat face is missing in the outside view, leaving the nose open (geometry.js:113, detail-44_rem_mag.jpg)
Shoulder angle α: the arc is drawn about the cone apex without cone extension lines and floats over the neck or bullet, away from the shoulder (drawing.js:199-206, detail-9_3_x_74_r.jpg)
Print: the drawing is held to a height of 108 mm, not full width (styles.css:122)
Labels: leader lines run through other labels (detail-308_win.jpg, P2/H1)
Title block: no frame, and the scale is shown only as a 10 mm bar
strengths: Faithful data presentation: tolerances next to values, D°M'S" angles, symbol mapping, grouped Symbol/Value/Unit tables, all values escaped

Geometry engine follows most rules exactly (chamfer, groove, belt at δ, fillets, tangent ogive, heel, walls, w, primer pocket) and is unit-tested against them, including a label-overlap check over all 25 records
Zero-dependency static app that works from file://, with hash deep links and a one-page A4 print
issues: Visible drawing errors: the 22 LR wall runs out to nothing at the mouth (straight-case wall blend), flat and semi-wadcutter noses are left open in the outside view, and the α arc floats over the neck or bullet instead of marking the shoulder

The drawing scales to the container, so label and title-block sizes vary wildly between cartridges (huge on 9 mm Luger and 22 LR, small on 308), and straight cases leave empty dimension rows; in print, table headers are bigger than the cells
No README, docs, ADRs or CI: nothing explains how to run, test or extend the app
review.verdict: A clean, dependency-free implementation whose data presentation, search and routing are solid and whose bottleneck drawings mostly match the references and the brief's rules. Visible geometry errors on straight, heeled and semi-wadcutter cases, the misplaced α arc, uneven drawing typography and the lack of any documentation keep it from being publishable as is.
